environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the image conversion service. Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with ImageMagick 6.9.11-60 installed via apt. The container runs as root with default Fargate capabilities. The task uses awsvpc networking with a public IP attached to an ALB. The ImageMagick policy.xml is the default Ubuntu package configuration which permits all coders including MVG, SVG, MSL, and ephemeral protocols. No seccomp profile override is applied.
